title: Double-Edged Enchantments (D.E.E.)
description: Do you want More Curses (and enchantments). Well here you go.
body:
This mods adds 12 new enchantments, 50 new Curses and make the level of each enchantment and curse to 10

Here are some additianal items:
- Echo-Peal (Teleport back)
- Spears (Trident-like weapons)
- Hexing table (Upgrade or Downgrade each Enchantment and Curse)
- Jettatuim Ore/Tools (Gets better when cursed)
